references.text: Mark's description of how Joseph of Arimathea took Jesus' body and wrapped it in a linen cloth
Luke's description of how Joseph of Arimathea took down Jesus' body, wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a tomb hewn out of the rock
John's description of how Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus took Jesus' body, bound it in linen cloths with aromatic spices, according to Jewish burial custom
The Pentateuch's description that Moses was buried by God can be seen as a precursor to the honorable treatment of Jesus' body
